name: Public awareness and education
outcome: Simplifying complex policies into relatable messages
detail: Clear, accessible and culturally sensitive messages tailored to different audiences, with public-education campaigns that build knowledge and national ownership of Dira 2050.

name: Stakeholder engagement and participation
detail: Meaningful citizen involvement in implementation and monitoring, with special attention to youth, women, persons with disabilities and rural communities so no one is left behind.

name: Institutional alignment
outcome: Consistent and coordinated messaging across government
detail: Harmonised communication among ministries, agencies and local governments to keep messaging consistent, share information and reduce duplication.

name: Transparency and accountability
detail: Timely, accurate information and open reporting of both progress and challenges, to build public trust and confidence.

name: Partnerships and advocacy
outcome: Media, private sector and partners as amplifiers
detail: Strategic engagement with traditional and digital media, journalists and influencers to widen reach, credibility and public confidence.
